class.name: TweensGdFX
class.description: Access through [code]Tweens.FX[/code]. Scalar functions work as [member TweensGdDefinition.ease_function]; vector and quaternion functions supply offsets to callbacks or custom interpolators. Frequency is cycles (Punch/Breathe) or noise intervals (Shake) per tween, not per second. Progress is clamped to [code][0, 1][/code]. Invalid configuration reports an error and returns an empty Callable. C# equivalent: [code]Tweens.FX[/code].

method.name: attack_release
breathe
method.description: Creates a repeating raised cosine between zero and amplitude. Phase is in cycles. Integer frequency and phase zero give zero at both ends; other settings preserve their phase.

method.name: breathe_2d
method.description: Creates a per-axis breathe offset sampler. Parameters use the scalar factory's units; defaults are shown in the signature.

method.name: breathe_3d
method.description: Creates a per-axis breathe offset sampler. Parameters use the scalar factory's units; defaults are shown in the signature.

method.name: breathe_quaternion
method.description: Creates a unit rotation offset from a breathe rotation vector. Amplitude components are radians. Apply locally as [code]baseline * sampler.call(progress)[/code].

method.name: decay
method.description: Creates an immediate amplitude envelope from one to zero. [param power] must be positive.

method.name: punch
method.description: Creates a damped sine, zero at the end. Phase is in cycles; phase zero starts at zero displacement. Attack zero starts with full envelope strength. Amplitude may be signed.

method.name: punch_2d
method.description: Creates a per-axis punch offset sampler. Parameters use the scalar factory's units; defaults are shown in the signature.

method.name: punch_3d
method.description: Creates a per-axis punch offset sampler. Parameters use the scalar factory's units; defaults are shown in the signature.

method.name: punch_quaternion
method.description: Creates a unit rotation offset from a punch rotation vector. Amplitude components are radians. Apply locally as [code]baseline * sampler.call(progress)[/code].

method.name: shake
method.description: Creates seeded value noise with a fading envelope. Offset is in noise coordinates. Positive attack starts at zero; attack zero permits immediate displacement. No mutable RNG or engine noise resource.

method.name: shake_2d
method.description: Creates a per-axis shake offset sampler. Parameters use the scalar factory's units; defaults are shown in the signature.

method.name: shake_3d
method.description: Creates a per-axis shake offset sampler. Parameters use the scalar factory's units; defaults are shown in the signature.

method.name: shake_quaternion
method.description: Creates a unit rotation offset from a shake rotation vector. Amplitude components are radians. Apply locally as [code]baseline * sampler.call(progress)[/code].
